title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, and Engineering. You will own the evolution of our field operations platform by understanding customer needs, identifying product opportunities, defining new capabilities, and guiding engineering teams through successful delivery.
  
  
Unlike an implementation or project management role, the Product Owner owns
**what gets built and why**

* Understand customer business processes and operational challenges.
* Participate in Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions when product expertise is required.
* Analyze customer pain points and identify opportunities to improve the platform.
* Recommend solutions using existing platform capabilities whenever possible.
* Identify feature gaps and define new product enhancements.
* Balance customer-specific requests with long-term product strategy.
* Partner with Product Leadership to prioritize roadmap initiatives.

* Create and manage Product JIRA stories and epics.
* Write clear functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Define workflows, user experiences, and business rules.
* Collaborate with UX and Engineering on solution design.
* Review Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and proposed workflows.
* Ensure solutions align with platform architecture and long-term scalability.

* Partner closely with Customer Success throughout client implementations.
* Provide guidance on platform capabilities and best practices.
* Support workflow discussions and solution design.
* Work closely with Engineering during development and implementation.
* Clarify requirements and answer functional questions throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and feature reviews.

* Own product features from concept through release.
* Validate completed features before release.
* Perform functional testing alongside Engineering.
* Ensure delivered functionality meets customer and business requirements.
* Communicate feature readiness, timelines, and release updates to Customer Success.

**Customer Partnership**

* Act as the product subject matter expert during strategic customer discussions.
* Help evaluate implementation approaches.
* Translate customer feedback into actionable product improvements.
* Support complex client implementations requiring product expertise.

**Continuous Product Improvement**

* Monitor customer feedback and adoption trends.
* Identify opportunities to improve usability, workflows, and platform capabilities.
* Recommend enhancements that increase scalability and reduce implementation effort.
* Contribute to long-term product vision and roadmap planning.

 Ahmedabad/GiftCity
   

  

**Description**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.

**Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**
**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.

* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Timelessly inspired, endlessly enhanced\- RENÉE Cosmetics is an Indian makeup brand that's redefining beauty with its range of high quality, cruelty\-free and FDA\-approved innovative range of products. RENÉE believes in empowering women to own and enjoy their bold, ambitious persona and let their glam do the talking. The art of cosmetics is a true liberator and a beautiful form of expressing oneself in tones and shades. We seek inspiration from timeless beauty and transform it to meet the needs of the modern woman
 



  





**Who Can Apply** 
 :
 **Only candidate working with a color cosmetic brand can apply** 




  





**Key Responsibility** 



* Lead and manage the complete product development process from ideation to commercialization
* Develop project timelines and ensure on\-time delivery of new product launch
* Research emerging beauty trends, consumer preferences, and competitor activity in color cosmetics
* Collaborate with Marketing to identify gaps and opportunities in the product portfolio
* Partner with R\&D to conceptualize and test formulations that align with brand guidelines and quality standards
* Work with packaging team to develop aesthetically appealing and functional packaging solutions
* Negotiate costs and maintain vendor relationships to ensure quality and timely delivery
* Ensure all products comply with local and global regulatory standards, including labeling and safety requirements.
* Oversee stability testing, safety testing, and consumer trials to ensure product efficacy and satisfaction
* Ensure continuous quality checks during and post\-production phases
* Work with the Marketing and Sales teams to create product launch strategi
* Collaborate with Supply Chain to ensure a seamless transition to mass production
* Monitor budgets for product development, including formulations, testing, and packaging
* Provide regular updates on costs and work to optimize resources



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA/Master’s/Bachelor's degree in Cosmetics Science, Chemistry, or related field
* 3\-6 years of experience in New Product Development within the cosmetics, beauty, or Skin/Personal Care industry
* Strong knowledge of formulation development and packaging processes for color cosmetics
